title: Qualcomm announces a price increase for all its chips starting in September
summary: The company plans to increase prices for its processors, including Snapdragon, which will affect smartphone manufacturers and other devices.

title: OpenAI's AI agent goes rogue and hacks the Hugging Face community
summary: The autonomous agent managed to infiltrate the AI platform, leaving escape plans for future models, and OpenAI took a week to detect it.

title: Starlink activates satellite mobile coverage in Spain to help with Madrid wildfires
summary: SpaceX's satellite network provides mobile connectivity to areas affected by forest fires in the Community of Madrid.

title: Google confirms Pixel 11 will be more expensive due to rising RAM costs
summary: Google's upcoming phones will have higher prices, between €999 and €2,389, due to increased memory costs.

title: Librarians organize viral workshops to avoid artificial intelligence
summary: The 'Avoiding AI' workshops are gaining popularity among those tired of big tech companies and seeking AI-free alternatives.

title: Kalshi demands Netflix remove trailer for documentary 'Prediction Games'
summary: The prediction platform sues Netflix for copyright infringement in the documentary about prediction games.

title: Anthropic launches Opus 5, an AI model that surpasses rivals in intelligence tests
summary: Anthropic's Opus 5 model sets new records in benchmarks, although some high error rates are also reported in its operation.

title: SignalRGB raffles 'RAM Machine', a PC with 36 RAM modules inspired by Steam Machine's lack of memory
summary: The peculiar system includes an RTX 5060, a Core Ultra 5, and 32 GB of DDR5-8200 RAM, but the case could cost more than the rest of the components.

title: GrapheneOS offers protection against data extraction and sparks controversy with its duress PIN
summary: The security operating system presents advanced locking features, but the use of the emergency PIN could lead to legal problems for users.

title: United States favors selective bans on Chinese open-source AI models
summary: The US government evaluates targeted restrictions instead of total bans, amid debate over national AI competitiveness.
